scope: 25 sets x English/Japanese = 50 independent source rows
counting_rules: Count distinct card numbers, not repeated page entries.
Do not count reprints as base cards in the original set.
Keep release-set assignment separate from card-number prefix.
Treat printings as distinct only where official product/printing identity supports it.
Do not infer missing cards or images from feed totals.
